title: Anauralia and aphantasia: Prevalence and distinct associations with personality, well-being and self-regulation in a large, representative sample.
summary: Prevalence rates and psychological correlates of anauralia (absence of auditory imagery) and aphantasia were examined in a large and representative sample (N = 32,784), by presenting two questions about sensory imagery in the 13th wave of the New Zealand Attitudes and Values Study (NZAVS). The single auditory and visual items employed showed excellent concordance with multi-item imagery questionnaires (Plymouth Sensory Imagery Questionnaire, VVIQ) and revealed closely similar prevalence rates for anauralia and aphantasia (.8%), with the latter showing excellent agreement with earlier estimates of aphantasia prevalence. Importantly, anauralia and aphantasia were associated with distinct psychological profiles. Anauralia, but not aphantasia, was associated with higher conscientiousness and contrary to our initial hypothesis anauralics reported better self-control, including superior control of health-related behaviours compared with individuals who experience typical auditory imagery. Aphantasics, but not anauralics, reported: higher levels of perfectionism and psychological distress; poorer wellbeing; lower self-esteem; and stronger feelings of being an outsider compared to participants reporting typical visual imagery. The latter comparisons of anauralic and aphantasic participants with those reporting typical imagery were highly reliable but relatively small in size (Glass's delta = .2 - .3). Contrary to hypothesis, individual differences in auditory imagery were unrelated to religious beliefs or frequency of praying. Implications of these findings are discussed.

标题：无听觉意象与无视觉意象：大型代表性样本中的 prevalence 及其与人格、幸福感和自我调节的独特关联
摘要：本研究通过新西兰态度与价值观研究（NZAVS）第13波数据，向大型代表性样本（N = 32,784）提出两个关于感觉意象的问题，考察了无听觉意象（anauralia）和无视觉意象（aphantasia）的流行率及其心理相关性。所采用的单条听觉与视觉条目与多项目意象问卷（普利茅斯感觉意象问卷、VVIQ）表现出极佳的一致性，并揭示无听觉意象与无视觉意象的流行率极为相近（0.8%），其中后者与此前对无视觉意象流行率的估计高度吻合。重要的是，无听觉意象与无视觉意象与不同的心理特征相关联。无听觉意象（而非无视觉意象）与更高的尽责性相关，且与我们的初始假设相反，无听觉意象者报告了更好的自我控制，包括在健康相关行为方面优于具有典型听觉意象的个体。无视觉意象者（而非无听觉意象者）报告了更高水平的完美主义和心理困扰、更差的幸福感、更低的自尊，以及与报告典型视觉意象的参与者相比更强的局外感。上述无听觉意象和无视觉意象参与者与典型意象报告者的比较高度可靠，但效应量相对较小（Glass's delta = .2 - .3）。与假设相反，听觉意象的个体差异与宗教信仰或祈祷频率无关。本文讨论了这些发现的启示。
关键词：无听觉意象；无视觉意象；情绪意象；人格；自我调节

title: Distinct neurocognitive pathways underlying the effects of ostracism and social rejection on visual perspective-taking.
summary: Social exclusion, including ostracism (being ignored) and social rejection (direct negative feedback), exerts different effects on visual perspective-taking (VPT). However, existing theories and empirical studies have failed to adequately explain these differences, with the underlying neurocognitive mechanisms remaining unclear. This study compared the behavioral and event-related potential (ERP) effects of ostracism (Cyberball game) and social rejection (modified get-acquainted paradigm) on VPT, quantifying three ERP components: fronto-central N200, centro-parietal P300 and temporo-parietal LSW, which reflect general conflict monitoring, conflict execution and sustained information integration, and specifically index self-other perspective conflict detection, perspective transformation resource investment and non-egocentric perspective maintenance in VPT respectively. Results showed the social rejection group had higher negative affect, reduced high-conflict VPT accuracy, larger N200 amplitudes and attenuated P300/LSW amplitudes (especially in the other-inconsistent condition), while the ostracism group exhibited slower VPT reaction times without accuracy loss or significant ERP attenuation. These findings indicate social rejection impairs VPT by heightening conflict monitoring, while ostracism affects VPT via cognitive deconstruction and processing slowing, two distinct pathways aligning with integrated theoretical interpretations. This study clarifies the need to distinguish ostracism and social rejection in social cognition research and provides neurocognitive evidence for VPT deficits after social exclusion.

标题：社会排斥与拒绝在视觉观点采择上的不同神经认知路径
摘要：社会排斥，包括社会忽视（被忽略）和社会拒绝（直接的负面反馈），对视觉观点采择（VPT）产生不同的影响。然而，现有理论和实证研究未能充分解释这些差异，其背后的神经认知机制仍不清楚。本研究比较了社会忽视（网络球游戏）和社会拒绝（修改的相识范式）对VPT的行为和事件相关电位（ERP）效应，量化了三个ERP成分：额中央N200、中央顶叶P300和颞顶叶LSW，它们分别反映了一般冲突监测、冲突执行和持续信息整合，并分别指示VPT中的自我-他人视角冲突检测、视角转换资源投入和非自我中心视角维持。结果显示，社会拒绝组具有更高的负性情绪、高冲突VPT准确率降低、N200波幅增大以及P300/LSW波幅减弱（尤其是在他人不一致条件下），而社会忽视组表现出VPT反应时变慢，但没有准确率损失或显著的ERP衰减。这些发现表明，社会拒绝通过增强冲突监测损害VPT，而社会忽视通过认知解构和加工减慢影响VPT，这两条不同的路径与整合性的理论解释相一致。本研究阐明了在社会认知研究中区分社会忽视与社会拒绝的必要性，并为社会排斥后的VPT缺陷提供了神经认知证据。
关键词：社会排斥；社会拒绝；社会忽视；视觉观点采择；事件相关电位
